meta.task: c1 electronics inside the key modules and end parts
meta.version: v4 W1+ r4.5 key action, circuit W1 rev B (BRD-01/BRD-02 2026-09-29) | A16 2026-10-31: whole 80 x 120 MB on the module floor under the separate balance rail
meta.coords: module_items: module local x (0 = C left boundary; world x = 47 + 164.5*(k-1) + x for octave module Ok), y from the white-key front lip, z from the desk. end_items: part="left" -> local x = world x (left end part x0..47); part="right" -> world x = 1198.5 + x; coords="world" items are already world.
meta.box: {x:[min,max], y:[..], z:[..], label}; optional show:false on a box = small detail; cut:true = subtract from its parent item
meta.cylinder: {axis, center:[a,b] in the two other axes (z-axis -> [x,y]; y-axis -> [x,z]), d, range:[min,max] along the axis, label}
meta.sweeps: usb_cable only: arc + line centreline for the flexible cable
meta.show: false = small circuit part (resistors, caps, headers, pads, leads) - do not render by default
meta.check: bbox + point-in-polygon check of every rendered box against the fixed parts of geometry.json (module, left, right end parts): no clash except (1) the hall bodies inside the sensor bar - the bar prism in geometry.json has no pockets, the sensor-bar STL must subtract each hall item pocket / lead_groove / lead_holes; (2) the frame locating pins D2.8 inside the board holes D3.0 (by design); (3) fin bbox false positives (the hung F|F# fin is at z>=21.5 behind y172, its foot only in the slot y<172)
meta.pedal_boards: none in the modules or end parts: PB (pedal board, RP2040-Zero) sits in the CU tray and PS (pedal sensor) inside the pedal (bom.csv SCH-05; final-bom L35 / L43)
